verdict.rationale: Unstructured's workflow and job APIs process many documents in one run. Workflows pull files from source connectors such as Azure Blob Storage and transform them into a destination. Jobs can partition, chunk, embed or enrich sets of local files. Users can trigger runs, monitor status, download results and inspect the individual files that failed, all via the SDK or REST. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of batch size or throughput limits, no bulk management of workflows or jobs themselves, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of large-scale batch runs.
